cohort: The study included 11,354 very preterm infants born in Switzerland between 2006 and 2022.
finding: The study identified effective screening criteria (GA < 27 weeks, birth weight < 1000 g, intraventricular haemorrhage>=IIdeg, congenital tumour) that would have detected all ROP treatment cases while reducing screening burden by 56%.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as a statistically significant risk factor for ROP treatment (aOR 1.84).
birth_weight: Birth weight < 1000 g was a key screening criterion, and birth weight z-score was a significant risk factor.
gest_age: The cohort had a median gestational age of 29.6 weeks (range 23.0-31.9 weeks), with GA < 27 weeks identified as a key screening criterion.
